case save 0 pos=0 pkg=1 hub=0 exist=0 brush=0 mover=0
make_directory "SavePath"
make_directory "SaveSlotPath"
format_slot_file 0 "SaveSlot/Save0.usa"
debugf_str "Saving game... filename: %s" "SaveSlot/Save0.usa"
level_info_set_action 2
paint_progress eng
localize_progress Saving
begin_slow_task "Localized"
cleanup_destroyed level 1
save_package level "SaveSlot/Save0.usa" ret=1
format_save_hub_file 0 0 "SaveSlot/Save00.usa"
file_size "SaveSlot/Save00.usa" ret=0
actor_is_mover levelinfo ret=0
new_brush_tracker level
end_slow_task
level_info_set_action 0
gcache_flush
save_persistent_actor_cache
